Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.hybrid

Class CorrectedVlpProvider

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.hybrid.CorrectedVlpProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
VlpProvider
public final class CorrectedVlpProvider extends Object implements VlpProvider
Fast lift curve (surrogate) that is periodically corrected against a high-fidelity reference model.

This is the link between the fast loop and the slow loop of the hybrid production model. The surrogate, typically a VfpTableLookup, is evaluated at every iteration of every time step. The reference, typically a live multiphase pipe or tubing model, is evaluated only when calibrate(double, double, double, double, double) is called at the current operating point; the difference is stored as an additive pressure offset and applied to the surrogate until the next calibration. With setUseReference(boolean) the reference is used directly for every evaluation (full network mode).

Version:
1.0
Author:
ESOL
